era_class.instructions: Which period best describes the market environment implied by this anonymized state?

criteria.early: An earlier period in the historical sample.
criteria.middle: A middle period in the historical sample.
criteria.late: A later period in the historical sample.

outcome_outperform.instructions: Will this fund outperform the broad group of similar funds over the next three trading days?

criteria.true: The fund is more likely than not to beat the equal-weight peer group over the next three sessions.
criteria.false: The fund is more likely than not to lag the equal-weight peer group over the next three sessions.
